text:
In xtask/src/site.rs, stop the Counters section from naming transition ids before they are defined. Either render Transitions before Counters, or have each id in Counters link to its transition and carry the transition's short name inline. Add a check in xtask/tests/site_page.rs that every transition id on the page is defined before, or linked at, its first use.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Study page Counters section names transition ids (t1, t3, ...) before the Transitions section defines them — flagged in ~15 audience ratings
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: xtask/src/site.rs, xtask/tests/site_page.rs
